    The main theorems for mod Λ #

    Assembly of the statements of Statement.lean from the library. The general results are proved for an abelian category with a length function; here they are specialized to the finite-dimensional modules over a finite-dimensional algebra. The enumeration of pretorsion theories of the linear quiver (Theorem 7.5 and the first half of Theorem B) is assembled from the cutoff description of PT(Λ_n), and the enumeration of image-closed subcategories (Theorem 8.5 and the second half of Theorem B) from the description of L_im(Λ_n) by intersection-closed interval families.
